# Classifieds
[italic]Notices from readers, set as received. The Herald does not vouch for any of it. Ravine families advertise free.[/italic]
## Housing - [bold]ROOM TO LET[/bold], township blocks, two minutes from the east greenhouse dome. Own rebreather locker, working CO alarm. Quiet tenant only, night shift preferred. Ask at the laundry. - [bold]WANTED[/bold], bunk space for a University of Albacetire student. Can pay half in rent and half in geology tutoring. - Official allocations are posted by the colony at [netlink="Seegson housing assignments" link="colony.seegson.net/housing"].
## Work - [bold]DOME HANDS WANTED[/bold] for the harvest rotation. Soil work, long hours, fresh food at the end of the shift. - [bold]HAULER DRIVER[/bold] needed for the ravine road. Must hold a heavy vehicle licence and keep a clear head when the haze comes in. - [bold]EXPERIENCED CORE DRILLER[/bold] seeks honest work with a firm that still logs its gas readings. References from before 2168.
## For Sale and Trade - [bold]CO MONITORS[/bold], recalibrated and bench tested. Forty credits each, or trade for rebreather filters. - [bold]MOTORBIKE[/bold], runs rough, needs a new chain. Will swap for a working radio. - [bold]WINTER COATS[/bold], children's sizes, outgrown but clean. Free to anyone who needs them.
## Lost and Found - [bold]LOST[/bold]: grey work dog, answers to Ballast, last seen near the mess hall. Reward of real coffee. - [bold]FOUND[/bold]: a miner's tag on the township road. Collect it at the press office by giving the name on it.
## Notices - The Ravine families meet on the last rest day of every month to read the names. All are welcome. - Whoever keeps borrowing the press office's good chair: we know, and we will print it.
To place a notice, find the Herald's correspondent or leave a comment under any story on the front page.
